theme.style: Warm editorial calm built from cream paper tones, muted sage green and dusty terracotta, lit like the last twenty minutes of daylight. Soft apricot-to-rose gradients drift across matte, faintly grained surfaces with no hard edges or glare. The mood is quiet and unhurried — generous negative space, serif restraint, and light that feels diffused through linen curtains rather than a screen.
